summary: Learn Digital Government and GovTech Implementation with GTMI, service blueprinting, governance, dashboards, and roadmaps. Book practical training.
lede: Digital government and GovTech implementation connects reform goals with practical plans for public-service delivery. For professionals coordinating policy, ICT, finance and service teams, it addresses planning and measuring delivery amid fragmented systems, legacy processes and budget limits. Learners practice GovTech Maturity Index assessments, service blueprinting, delivery governance, KPI dashboards and implementation roadmaps, with interoperability and digital public infrastructure covered at an overview level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals working on digital public service reform, GovTech implementation, and service governance who need practical methods for planning and measuring delivery.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, a current public-service or GovTech use case, and any available service metrics, governance charts, or programme notes. Familiarity with basic project delivery, public administration, or digital service operations will help you get the most from the exercises.
